limitations: Synthetic geometry and mock RR; no game quality or actual AMD RR timing.
No stable full-wrapper incremental policy estimate: large paired differences also occur in sham controls.
Timestamp observer may perturb scheduling; all compared arms use identical observer.
Allocation charges are not measured residency; provider opaque resources are absent.
Anchor timing excludes NZR and is not the recommended preset timing.
